# Troubleshooting

## The client cannot connect

<!-- @sdk-kit:keep connect — service-owned: endpoint checks; kept by "sdk-kit sync" -->

- `health()` returns `healthy: false, status: "unreachable"`: the query URL is wrong or Jaeger is
  down. Check `GROW_JAEGER_URL` / `JAEGER_QUERY_URL` (default `http://127.0.0.1:16686`, the query
  port, not the OTLP ports 4317/4318) and that the port is reachable from where your code runs
  (inside Docker, `127.0.0.1` is the container itself).
- `health()` returns `status: "degraded"`: the query service answers but the healthcheckv2
  endpoint at `healthUrl` (port 13133, `/status`) reports a problem; see the `healthcheck.*`
  entries in `details`.
- The remote sampler never gets a strategy: check `samplingUrl` (`GROW_JAEGER_SAMPLING_URL` /
  `JAEGER_SAMPLING_ENDPOINT`, default `http://127.0.0.1:5778/sampling`). Until the first poll
  succeeds it samples at `initialSamplingRate` (0.001); a failed poll keeps the last strategy.

<!-- @sdk-kit:endkeep -->

- Calls fail with `UNAVAILABLE` after several seconds: the client retried with backoff. Lower
  `maxRetries` or `totalTimeout` to fail faster.
- Behind a corporate proxy: `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` are **ignored** on purpose. Set `proxy`
  (or `GROW_JAEGER_PROXY`).

## `CONFIG` errors

The message names the setting or environment variable, never its value. Typical causes: a URL
without `http://` or `https://`, a duration such as `10 sec` (use `10s` or `10000`), a client
certificate without its key, `MAX_RETRIES` below 0.

## `AUTHENTICATION` or `PERMISSION_DENIED`

- `ping()` is the quickest credential check: it makes one authenticated call.

<!-- @sdk-kit:keep authentication — service-owned: which credentials the SDK reads; kept by "sdk-kit sync" -->

- Stock Jaeger has no authentication. `AUTHENTICATION`/`PERMISSION_DENIED` come from a reverse
  proxy in front of it: set its bearer token in `token` (`GROW_JAEGER_TOKEN`), which is sent as
  `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on query and sampling requests. `health()` never sends it.
- Explicit config values win over the environment (see
  [Service settings](configuration.md#service-settings)).

<!-- @sdk-kit:endkeep -->

- The SDK never prints credentials, so `toString()` of the config shows `[REDACTED]` even when a
  credential is set.

## TLS errors

- Self-signed or private CA: set `tls.caCertPath` (`GROW_JAEGER_CA_CERT`).
- Mutual TLS: set both `tls.clientCertPath` and `tls.clientKeyPath`.
- `tls.insecureSkipVerify` only for local tests.

## `RATE_LIMITED`

The service asked the client to slow down. The client waits for `Retry-After` up to
`maxRetryAfter` (60 s); longer waits fail at once with `retryAfter` set on the error so your code
can schedule a later attempt.

## `TIMEOUT`

`requestTimeout` (30 s) bounds one attempt and `totalTimeout` (120 s) the whole call including
retries. Raise them for slow operations, or pass a per-call deadline (signal, ctx, cancel token,
future timeout).

## See what the client does

Turn on the [logger](hooks.md#logger) or add [hooks](hooks.md#hooks): both see every attempt with
redacted headers and URLs.

## Docker integration tests fail

- Run one language: `make test-docker LANGS=go`.
- In CI, download the `compose-logs-<lang>` artifact of the failed job.
- Locally, the stack is removed after each run; rerun with Docker logs open
  (`docker compose -f docker/compose.yml logs -f`) in a second terminal.

<!-- @sdk-kit:keep service — service-owned: Jaeger-specific problems (own ## sections); kept by "sdk-kit sync" -->

## Traces do not show up

- Spans go to the OTLP ports (HTTP 4318, gRPC 4317), not to the query port 16686. Check
  `GROW_JAEGER_OTLP_HTTP_ENDPOINT` / `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` (see
  [Tracing setup](functions/tracing-setup.md#environment)).
- Spans are batched: call `forceFlush()` or `shutdown()` on the tracing handle before you query.
  An exported span is queryable about 200 ms after the export ack, so poll with `waitForTrace`
  instead of a single `getTrace`.
- With the remote sampler, the initial rate is 0.001 until the first strategy arrives, so most
  early traces are not sampled. Use `SamplingPreset.development` (always on) in tests.

<!-- @sdk-kit:endkeep -->

## Still stuck?

Open an issue with the language, package version, Jaeger version and a minimal reproduction
(with secrets removed): <https://github.com/grow-codes-packages/jaeger/issues>.
